title: db-studio
description: Launch Drizzle Studio against the host database.

config.description: Path to the host's ortha.config.ts (relative to the workspace root).

host.description: Host interface Studio's local server binds to (drizzle-kit default: 127.0.0.1).

port.description: Port Studio's local server listens on (drizzle-kit default: 4983).
